title: Agent cards
summary: One unit of agent work (a run, a task, a job) as a card that keeps working while folded: a status chip, one line of activity, a decision on the card, and the composer's levels on a strip.
purpose: AgentCard and AgentChat over a scripted agent: one card per state (queued, running, needs you, done, failed) with three agents in three colours, plus a task card (the same card with a meta). Folded, a card shows the agent's colour dot, a title, a status chip and one line; a decision the agent waits for shows on the folded card. The strip on its lower border goes folded, a small tray (the conversation and its field), the whole chat, or docks it into a side column.

fixture.usage: <AgentCard controller={controller} agent={{ name: 'Ledger', color: 'chart-1' }} title="Match the January payments" status={{ label: 'Done', tone: 'success' }} meta={<>Assignee, due date…</>} dock={dockElement} />

notes: The cards stay mounted while folded: the running card keeps updating its line, and the needs-you card shows the kit's approval card on the folded card, with a warning ring and no auto-expand. The colour of an agent is one of the theme's chart tokens; the header is tinted from it. The strip is the composer's own.

flows.name: Levels by the strip, back with Esc

steps.expect: The small tray opens: the conversation and its field.

steps.say: Press a key (focus then shows as a keyboard focus)
Focus the chevron (it reveals the controller)

steps.expect: The whole chat opens with its header in the agent's colour.
The card folds and focus returns to its header.
A tap on the header expands it.
Esc folds the card; focus is on its header.

flows.name: A decision on the folded card

steps.say: Look at the card that needs you
steps.expect: The approval is on the folded card; nothing opened by itself.
The agent carries on and the card says Done.
The card says Running and what the agent does, without opening.

flows.name: Dock the chat in the side column

steps.say: Press a key (focus then shows as a keyboard focus)
Focus the chevron (it reveals the controller)

steps.expect: The chat moves to the column; the card stays in the list, marked docked.
The chat goes back to the card.
